services.name: Palmetto Dunes Lagoon Charter
services.desc: Try some of the best fishing on Hilton Head Island - all while in the flat, calm waters of the Palmetto Dunes Resort lagoon system. A nursery to a variety of saltwater fish species, this lagoon system holds giant redfish, trout, bluefish, black drum, flounder and even tarpon. Take a Hilton Head Island fishing charter led by one of our native guides in a quiet, electric skiff.
